scripts.prepare: node --eval "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const git = spawnSync('git', ['rev-parse', '--git-dir'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); if (git.status === 0) { const result = spawnSync('git', ['config', 'core.hooksPath', '.githooks'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exitCode = result.status ?? 1 }"
